evidence: Key invariants for daily work: I1 (SPEC IS SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — P2 blocked until P1 locked; P3 blocked until P2 locked). I4 (VERIFICATION IS EXPLICIT — every output passes declared gate; max 3 REVISE cycles; at 3 failures Attestation required). I6 (RUNTIME IS VENDOR-NEUTRAL — no model names anywhere; use capability descriptors only: code-generation, analysis, synthesis, long-context). I8 (SELF-IMPROVEMENT THROUGH EVIDENCE — Execution->Receipt->Instinct->Synth->Blueprint->Augment->Benchmark->Forge; no stage skips; self-promotion requires Attestation). I10 (RECEIPTS ARE OPERATIONAL ARTIFACTS — every non-trivial execution writes a receipt; implied completion prohibited). I11 (FRAMEWORK AND PRODUCT NEVER MIX — .wabblespec/ is framework space; project/repo/ is product space; never cross the boundary). Full table: _shared/references/invariants.md.
